qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Suncor controls an integrated mine-to-pump oil sands empire (Millennium, Steepbank, Fort Hills, Syncrude), upgraders, and the nationwide Petro-Canada retail network. Despite physical scale and operational improvements under new leadership, Suncor possesses zero pricing power over benchmark crude oil or refined fuel prices.
qualitative.note: Rejected at Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing Power). Suncor is a capital-intensive integrated oil producer subject to volatile commodity pricing and operational hazards. Through-cycle 10-year median ROIC falls well short of the 12% moat hurdle, with negative returns during downturns.
qualitative.evidence: ROIC collapsed into negative territory during 2015-2016 and again in 2020 (-2.5% to -5%), forcing a 55% dividend cut in 2020. Even with the 2022 windfall pricing spike, Suncor's 10-year through-cycle median ROIC is ~7-9%, well below the 12% threshold, confirming cyclical commodity price-taker status.
